1.text: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

2.text: They who are during their prayer humbly intent

3.text: And they who turn away from ill speech

4.text: And they who are observant of zakāh

5.text: And they who guard their private parts

6.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,<sup foot_note="227326">1</sup> for indeed, they will not be blamed -

footnotes.227326: - Female slaves or captives under their ownership.

7.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

8.text: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

9.text: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

11.text: Who will inherit al-Firdaus.<sup foot_note="227327">1</sup> They will abide therein eternally.

12.text: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

13.text: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop<sup foot_note="227328">1</sup> in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].

14.text: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.<sup foot_note="227329">1</sup>

footnotes.227329: - i.e., the most skillful and only true Creator.

15.text: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

16.text: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

17.text: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

18.text: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

19.text: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

20.text: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.

21.text: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

22.text: And upon them and on ships you are carried.

23.text: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

24.text: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

25.text: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

26.text: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

27.text: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows,<sup foot_note="227330">1</sup> put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

28.text: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

29.text: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"

30.text: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

31.text: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

32.text: And We sent among them a messenger<sup foot_note="227331">1</sup> from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

footnotes.227331: - Prophet Hūd, who was sent to the tribe of ʿAad.

33.text: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

34.text: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

35.text: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

36.text: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.<sup foot_note="227332">1</sup>

footnotes.227332: - i.e., how distant and improbable it is.

37.text: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

38.text: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."

39.text: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

40.text: [Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

41.text: So the shriek<sup foot_note="227333">1</sup> seized them in truth,<sup foot_note="227334">2</sup> and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

footnotes.227334: i.e., by right or in justice.

42.text: Then We produced after them other generations.

43.text: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].

44.text: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations.<sup foot_note="227335">1</sup> So away with a people who do not believe.

footnotes.227335: - i.e., history or lessons for mankind.

45.text: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority<sup foot_note="227336">1</sup>

46.text: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

47.text: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"

48.text: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

49.text: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they<sup foot_note="227337">1</sup> would be guided.

50.text: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

51.text: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.

52.text: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion,<sup foot_note="227338">1</sup> and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

53.text: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has,<sup foot_note="227339">1</sup> rejoicing.

54.text: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

55.text: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

56.text: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.<sup foot_note="227340">1</sup>

footnotes.227340: - That the good things given to them in this world are but a trial for them.

57.text: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

58.text: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

59.text: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

60.text: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful<sup foot_note="227341">1</sup> because they will be returning to their Lord -

footnotes.227341: - Lest their deeds not be acceptable.

61.text: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.

62.text: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

63.text: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,

64.text: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment,<sup foot_note="227342">1</sup> at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.

footnotes.227342: - In worldly life, before the punishment of the Hereafter.  Although general, the description includes specifically the punishment of the Quraysh by famine.

65.text: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

66.text: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

67.text: In arrogance regarding it,<sup foot_note="227343">1</sup> conversing by night, speaking evil.

footnotes.227343: - The revelation.  Or "him," i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ).

68.text: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

69.text: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

70.text: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

71.text: But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message,<sup foot_note="227344">1</sup> but they, from their message, are turning away.

72.text: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

73.text: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

74.text: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

75.text: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

76.text: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

77.text: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

78.text: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.

79.text: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

80.text: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

81.text: Rather,<sup foot_note="227345">1</sup> they say like what the former peoples said.

82.text: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

83.text: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

84.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

85.text: They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

86.text: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

87.text: They will say, "[They belong] to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

88.text: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

89.text: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"

90.text: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.

91.text: Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].

92.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

93.text: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

94.text: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

95.text: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.

96.text: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

97.text: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

98.text: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

99.text: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

100.text: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind."<sup foot_note="227346">1</sup> No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

101.text: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

102.text: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

103.text: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

104.text: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.<sup foot_note="227347">1</sup>

footnotes.227347: - Their lips having been contracted by scorching until the teeth are exposed.

105.text: [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

106.text: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

107.text: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."

108.text: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

109.text: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

110.text: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

111.text: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."

112.text: [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

113.text: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

114.text: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

115.text: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

116.text: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign,<sup foot_note="227348">1</sup> the Truth;<sup foot_note="227349">2</sup> there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

footnotes.227348: And owner of everything in existence.

117.text: And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

118.text: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
